notes: Table structure (lines 286-301, flattened from a 2-column table): header row 体を温めるもの (286) / 体を冷やすもの (287); three row headers 野菜 (288), フルーツ (293), 飲み物 (297). Each warm-column cell is immediately followed by the matching cool-column cell, so the reading order is warm-cell, cool-cell per row. Row headers 野菜/フルーツ/飲み物 are structural (one per row, spanning BOTH columns) and are NOT coded as foods with a direction. Serving-temperature items: 冷たい飲み物 (301, protocol's named example; also appears in prose at 285 「温活では、冷たい飲み物やカラダを冷やす食べ物は避けるようにしましょう。」) and its symmetric counterpart 温かい飲み物 (299), which sits at the end of the warm 飲み物 cell and likewise denotes serving temperature, not a food's nature — both excluded from foods. EXCLUDED per §8 precedent: 白湯 and 生姜湯 (line 298, warm 飲み物 cell) as prepared beverages rather than a food's nature; 黒糖 and はちみつ (line 319, recipe note 「甘味が欲しい場合は黒糖やはちみつを加えてもOK」) as a substitute/optional-addition recommendation with no nature attribution. Coffee is coded cool strictly on the 体を冷やすもの column header (§3 final bullet). 発酵食品 (302-303) is coded warm from running prose outside the table (「カラダを温める作用があります」), the only direction-assigning statement on the page outside the two-column table. Recipes (306-320) 「にんじんりんごジュース」 and 「辛さ際立つ生姜紅茶」 name にんじん/りんご/生姜/紅茶 but assign no nature there; にんじん appears as 人参 in the table (coded), 生姜 only as 加熱した生姜. The long tag list (lines 22-186) includes food-ish tags (クコの実, サンザシ, なつめ, スーパーフード, ヨクイニン) with no direction attached — not coded. No neutral direction is stated anywhere on the page.
